scope: Source design specification only; author FOR plus fresh non-author full review and focused exact-clause corrective addendum. This is not two fresh full audits.

rows.clause: The first live flow is the bounded invoice-partial subset executed as T0 reference scripts, T1 genesis, T2 C2 claim mint (+1), and T3 one atomic transaction that spends the S2p thread input and the C2 claim input, executes c2.mint Burn (-1) with no C2 token in any output, carries the Ed25519 claimant VKH in transaction extra_signatories, and withdraws zero from VI, VS1, VS2, VS3 and VS4; there is no post-success claim-burn transaction, and a separate claimant-signed claim burn exists only as the alternative post-expiry refund (validity lower bound after env.expiry) when T3 never settles, because claim.release checks settle_outref against the current transaction inputs and not chain history; claim mint alone is never described as end-to-end.

rows.clause: The funded wallet UTxO spent by T1 Genesis as seed (from which thread_id is derived) and the T1 thread output outref locked at Script(s2p_hash) are distinct values: env.settle_outref in the fresh T2 statement and envelope is the actual confirmed T1 thread outref, consumed by T3, and never the already-spent wallet seed.

rows.clause: Authorisation is per-contract and objective: the S2p c2_hash parameter plus the genesis-frozen catalogue ActionEntry (predicate, vk and shape digests) is the verifier identity; no protocol registry, Moriarty-language compile/prove/deploy admission, maintainer admission or root approval is introduced, and claim.issue alone (which accepts any self-consistent VK/proof pair) is never described as authorised-relation binding.

rows.clause: A fresh secp256k1 intent account keypair must be generated and privately custodied and its public key frozen in catalogue.accounts at T1 as a prerequisite; the Ed25519 Preprod wallet key signs only Cardano transaction fields (T3 claimant extra_signatory, fee and collateral) and is never an intent or proving key; existing wallet keygen AUTH is spent, no existing key use is granted here, and any future proving-key read requires fresh exact-scope private-custody authorisation after descriptor and source-pin comparison, native key reuse for a changed context being UNPERFORMED.
rows.reviewerRationale: Verified against FIRST-PREPROD-DESIGN.md lines 16-17, CLAIM-BINDING-MATRIX.json B6/B7/B8/B10/B14, EXPERIMENT-OBLIGATIONS.json O-KEY-1/TF-N8, payment.addr (addr_test1vzt2n53u2vlr8ggxz8xan6ywrw8m55umfwvrgmzh3wmcmkcfxunjc), and payment.vkey.hash (96a9d23c533e33a10611cdd9e88e1b8fba539b4b98346c578bb78ddb): VI requires secp256k1 (32-byte Schnorr or 33-byte SEC1 ECDSA) intent signatures under domain /2, while the Ed25519 wallet key signs only Cardano transaction/claimant fields, and any private key generation/signing or proving-key read requires fresh internal operator scope after descriptor/source-pin verification.

rows.clause: The Rust statement is a 343-byte header (tag, family, predicate and shape as constants) plus a program-dependent body whose length and order derive from the selected program and action; the full statement is BLAKE2b-256 hashed into two public-input halves; the context segment is hashed free witness bytes over caller-supplied values that are not ledger authentication; ContextInput networkId is the ABI u8 byte and is not a conversion of Preprod magic 1; admission is exactly Core1/SettlementHashV2/NotBound/GrossDebitAndFees/TouchedOnly with /2 refused as staged-not-lowered and no invoice filename allowlist; compile_selected takes no context, changing source asset identities can change program, shape and descriptor, and no fixed universal body length is claimed.
rows.reviewerRationale: Verified against CLAIM-BINDING-MATRIX.json B10, FIRST-PREPROD-DESIGN.md line 12, EXPERIMENT-OBLIGATIONS.json O-RUST-1, and REVIEW-QUALIFICATIONS.json line 99: the ABI v2 statement has a 343-byte header and a program-dependent body (correcting REVIEW-3.json's universal 721-byte assumption), context bytes are free witness inputs authenticated only by on-chain S2p/shard4 recomputation, networkId is a u8 ABI byte rather than a conversion of Preprod magic 1, and admission is strictly Core1/SettlementHashV2/NotBound/GrossDebitAndFees/TouchedOnly.
